facts.fact: Acting Inspector-General Nainda says the Force Case Docket Management System is accessible at all Class A and Class B police stations and about 90% of Class C stations, within an E-Policing System implemented from 2014.

Acting Inspector-General Nainda told New Era the Force Case Docket Management System is accessible at all Class A and Class B stations and about 90% of Class C stations; no count of stations or share entering cases is given.
